author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: बहुदंष्ट्राभिः करालं विरूपम् । लोकाः भक्तवर्गाः भक्ताभक्तवर्गार्थत्वे तु लोकत्रयमित्यत्रेवाभिप्रायो ध्येयः । तथाऽहमपि प्रव्यथितः ॥ ११.२३॥
translation: Seeing Thy great form of many mouths and eyes, O Mighty-armed, of many arms, thighs and feet, of many breasts, terrific with fearful teeth, the worlds are terror-struck, as also am I. (23)
